symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Checkout degradation is isolated to the order-service to payment-service edge: 6 of 12 POST /payments calls timed out (HttpTimeoutException, 3s) while payment-service shows no restarts, no errors, and normal latency (mean 0.012s). Those 6 orders stayed PAYMENT_PENDING. Payment-service and gateway-mock answered their calls successfully; payment-service requests with 10s max latency are a single-tail effect. Root cause location is not clearly established, so confidence is low.
